src/Scans/args_form.jl:7 now defines `const ARGS_BULLET = r"The\s+arguments\s+are:"` (whitespace-tolerant regex, not a literal substring), with a comment noting the marker line-wraps in this package's own prose. `bulleted = occursin(ARGS_BULLET, d.body)` at line 46 uses it.

Comment at lines 16-18 explains why stripping `->` first would be unsound instead.
